description: This source file defines the WindowPlacement enum with static methods for positioning NSWindow instances on the screen, such as centering, placing at top-right, positioning below a given rectangle, and ensuring the window is on-screen. It is used for managing window layouts in a macOS application.

methods.name: centeredFrame(size:on:)
methods.description: Returns a rectangle centered within the specified screen or bounds for the given size.

methods.name: topRightFrame(size:padding:on:)
methods.description: Calculates a rectangle positioned at the top-right corner of the specified screen or bounds with padding.

methods.name: centeredFrame(size:in:)
methods.description: Returns a rectangle centered within specified bounds for the given size.

methods.name: topRightFrame(size:padding:in:)
methods.description: Calculates a rectangle at the top-right of given bounds with specified padding and size.

methods.name: anchoredBelowFrame(size:anchor:padding:in:)
methods.description: Positions a rectangle below a given anchor rectangle with padding, clamped within bounds.

methods.name: ensureOnScreen(window:defaultSize:fallback:)
methods.description: Ensures the window is visible on some screen, centering or using fallback if necessary.
